_comment: Reference mcp.json for the drillr MCP server. Drop the `mcpServers.drillr` block into your host's mcp.json. No key: the host signs in through the browser on first use. A host with no OAuth support can add "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <YOUR_DRILLR_API_KEY>" } using a key from https://drillr.ai/developer/keys.
